acquirer.name: Fidelity Systematic Municipal Bond Index ETF

listed_quote.quote: In April 2025, Fidelity® Municipal Bond Index Fund will be converted from a mutual fund to an ETF.

announcement.quote: Fidelity Investments announced plans to convert Fidelity® Municipal Bond Index Fund and Fidelity® Municipal Core Plus Bond Fund into exchange traded funds (ETFs).

outcome_evidence.quote: In April 2025, Fidelity® Municipal Bond Index Fund will be converted from a mutual fund to an ETF.

deals.notes: Mutual fund to ETF conversion (reorganization into a newly created ETF), not a merger of two listed closed-end funds. Target CIK shown is the trust (Fidelity Salem Street Trust) from the filing header; the fund is a series. Acquirer CIK is the trust (Fidelity Merrimack Street Trust).

target.name: Fidelity Municipal Core Plus Bond Fund

listed_quote.quote: If shareholders approve the Conversion, Fidelity® Municipal Core Plus Bond Fund will be converted from a mutual fund to an ETF in April 2025.

announcement.quote: Fidelity Investments announced plans to convert Fidelity® Municipal Bond Index Fund and Fidelity® Municipal Core Plus Bond Fund into exchange traded funds (ETFs).

outcome_evidence.quote: If shareholders approve the Conversion, Fidelity® Municipal Core Plus Bond Fund will be converted from a mutual fund to an ETF in April 2025.
